figures.description: 中午十二點十分的學生餐廳，牆上貼著「吃多少、拿多少」的標語。左邊一排學生拿著餐盤在取餐檯前排隊，打菜的工作人員正把飯菜放進餐盤；中間一個男生端著裝滿飯菜的餐盤四處張望，在找空位；右邊的長桌坐滿了邊吃邊聊的學生；最右邊的回收區有兩個學生正把剩菜倒進廚餘桶，再把餐盤疊好。

questions.stem: 提示：中午的學生餐廳常常擠滿了人，有人排隊取餐，有人端著餐盤找座位。請仔細看下面的圖片，寫一篇英文作文，文分兩段。第一段描述圖中學生餐廳裡的學生們正在做什麼；第二段寫出你自己平常在哪裡、怎麼吃午餐，並說明你比較喜歡這種用餐方式的原因。

1.explanation_zh: 這一題有三個要求：第一段描述圖中餐廳裡的學生在做什麼（排隊取餐、找座位、邊吃邊聊、收餐盤）；第二段寫自己平常在哪裡、怎麼吃午餐，再說明比較喜歡這種方式的原因。「比較喜歡」暗示要和別的方式對照，例如在教室吃和到餐廳吃各有什麼好處。
evidence: 第一段描述圖中學生餐廳裡的學生們正在做什麼
說明你比較喜歡這種用餐方式的原因
1.strategy_zh: 第一段照「左、中、右、出口」的順序一組一句；第二段先說地點與方式，再用 First、Second 列出兩個理由，最後加一個具體的例子。
hints: 第一段：On the left, … In the middle, … On the right, …
第二段：I usually eat lunch in … 接 I prefer … for two reasons.
理由後面補一件真的發生過的事，內容會更具體

moves.zh: 描述圖中學生餐廳裡的學生們正在做什麼
寫出你自己平常在哪裡、怎麼吃午餐
說明你比較喜歡這種用餐方式的原因

content.focus_zh: 第一段寫出圖中至少三項活動；第二段要說清楚自己在哪裡、怎麼吃午餐，並給出至少兩個比較喜歡的理由與一個具體例子。

bands.descriptor_zh: 回應題目的每一項要求，主旨明確；用具體的事例、細節或親身經驗撐起每個重點。
大致回應題目，但有一項要求寫得單薄，或細節偏籠統、說服力不足。
漏掉題目的主要要求或主旨模糊，多數句子空泛、重複或偏離題目。
空白、離題、只抄題目，或內容少到無法判斷要說什麼。

organization.focus_zh: 第一段依位置描述，第二段用 First、Second 列理由；理由與例子要扣回「比較喜歡」，結尾回應題目。

bands.descriptor_zh: 兩段分工清楚，各有主題句；句與句、段與段的銜接自然，轉承語用得恰當，篇幅分配合理。
段落大致分明，但有的地方跳接或重複，轉承語偏少或用得生硬。
重點排列混亂，前後句常接不起來，讀者不容易跟上。
看不出段落與順序，句子彼此無關。

grammar.focus_zh: 描述圖片用現在進行式；a line of students is waiting 的主詞是 a line，動詞用單數；寫上週的事用過去式。

bands.descriptor_zh: 句子幾乎沒有文法、標點錯誤，能交替使用簡單句、複句與不同的句首。
偶有時態、單複數或標點錯誤，但讀得懂意思；句型變化有限。
錯誤多到常讓人誤解意思，句子結構常不完整。
幾乎沒有正確的句子，無法理解。

vocabulary.focus_zh: 餐盤、排隊、午睡等字（tray、wait in line、take a nap）要用對；避免一直重複 eat 和 good。

bands.descriptor_zh: 用字精準、貼切，搭配自然，少有重複；拼字與大小寫幾乎全對。
字彙範圍偏窄、常重複同幾個字，偶有用字不當或拼錯，但不妨礙理解。
用錯字或拼錯字很多，常讓人看不懂。
幾乎每個字都用錯或拼錯，無法理解。

rubric.deductions_zh: 字數明顯不足（少於 100 個單詞）或沒有分成兩段，各扣總分 1 分；兩種情形同時發生只扣 1 分。離題或空白以 0 分計。

model_texts.label: steady
model_texts.text:
The picture shows a busy school cafeteria at noon. On the left, a long line of students is waiting for food with trays in their hands. Behind the counter, a cook is putting rice and vegetables on their trays. In the middle, a boy is holding his tray and looking around for an empty seat. On the right, many students are sitting at a long table, and they are eating and chatting happily. Near the door, two students are emptying their trays into a bin and putting the trays in a neat pile. There is also a sign on the wall that tells everyone not to waste food.
Unlike the students in the picture, I usually eat lunch in my classroom. Our lunch boxes are sent to each class, so we do not have to wait in line. I prefer eating in the classroom for two reasons. First, it saves time, and I can take a short nap after lunch. Second, eating with my classmates makes lunch more fun. For example, last Friday we shared our side dishes and voted for the best one, and my friend's fried egg won. However, the cafeteria has more choices, so I sometimes eat there when I want noodles. In conclusion, eating in the classroom is the best choice for me because it is quick and relaxing.

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 第一段寫出四組人的活動，第二段有地點、兩個理由與一件具體的事（內容 4）；First、Second 讓理由很清楚，但段落銜接較單純（組織 4）；句子正確，句型以簡單句為主（文法句構 4）；用字正確，但多是常用字（字彙拼字 3）。總分 15，屬穩健版。

model_texts.label: top
model_texts.text:
At ten past twelve, the cafeteria in the picture is as crowded as a train station at rush hour. Along the left wall, a line of hungry students stretches toward the serving counter, where a smiling cook is scooping rice and vegetables onto each tray. In the middle of the room, a boy balancing a full tray is searching for an empty seat, but nearly every long table is already occupied by friends chatting between bites. For most of them, lunch is clearly the best part of the school day. Near the exit, by contrast, the scene is surprisingly orderly. Two students are scraping their leftovers into a food-waste bin and stacking their trays under a sign that reminds everyone to take only what they can finish.
Although the cafeteria offers more variety, I prefer having lunch in my classroom, and my reasons go beyond convenience. To begin with, our class orders lunch boxes, so instead of waiting in line for fifteen minutes, I can eat right away and still enjoy a twenty-minute nap. More importantly, sharing a meal at our desks has turned lunch into an informal class meeting. Last spring, for instance, we noticed that nearly a third of our lunch boxes came back half full. After a short discussion over lunch, we reached a consensus and asked the school for smaller portions of rice. Within a month, the amount of food we threw away dropped sharply. The cooks even thanked us. Admittedly, eating in the same room where we study all morning can feel a little dull. Even so, I would not trade this daily ritual for the noisy cafeteria. In short, those unhurried meals have shown me that lunch is not only about filling our stomachs; it is also a chance to notice a problem together and solve it as a team.

notes.text: is not only about filling our stomachs; it is also a chance

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 圖片描述有比喻與動作細節，經驗段有理由、數據、讓步，並從自己延伸到全班一起解決剩食（內容 5）；理由分層清楚、結尾提出見解（組織 5）；分詞片語、as…as、not only…also 等句型多樣且正確（文法句構 5）；consensus、ritual 用得貼切，但整體以常用字為主（字彙拼字 4）。總分 19，屬頂標版。

steady.comment_zh: 排隊、打菜、找座位、邊吃邊聊、倒廚餘疊餐盤與標語都寫到；第二段說明在教室吃便當，用 First／Second 列兩個理由，並舉上週五分享配菜、投票選出最好吃的菜的例子，還有讓步句，內容完整、組織清楚、沒有語言錯誤。句型以簡單句和 because、so 為主，字彙正確但偏基本；結論的 quick and relaxing 和第二個理由（比較有趣）沒有完全呼應；圖中沒有門，「Near the door」是自行加上的位置。

top.comment_zh: 比喻（as crowded as a train station at rush hour）、分詞片語與對比轉折運用自如；第二段以 To begin with／More importantly 帶出兩個理由，用全班發現便當剩三分之一、討論後請學校減少飯量的經驗，把「比較喜歡」寫得具體又有層次，讓步後回到立場，結尾點出午餐的意義。沒有語言錯誤。小瑕疵：圖中標語貼在上方中間，「stacking their trays under a sign」和圖的位置不完全相符；Near the exit 也是自行加上的位置。

issues_zh: （參考，不影響判定）評分規準要求「至少兩個理由與一個具體例子」並在字彙重點列出 take a nap，比題目的「說明原因」多出範文才有的細節，建議改成通用敘述。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段依位置寫出排隊取餐、盛菜、找座位、邊吃邊聊、回收餐盤與「不浪費」標語；第二段交代在教室用餐的方式，用 First、Second 列出兩項理由，並以上週五分享配菜投票的例子支撐，也提到偶爾去餐廳吃麵。文法無誤，但 eat／eating 重複多次，字彙範圍偏窄。另外「Near the door」在圖中沒有對應的門。

top.comment_zh: 第一段不只描述，還用比喻帶出擁擠與秩序的對比，並點出「吃多少、拿多少」標語；第二段交代在教室吃便當的方式，用 To begin with、More importantly 列兩項理由，再以減少廚餘、請學校減少飯量的完整經驗支撐，最後承認缺點並回到主張。文法、用字皆精準自然，未見錯誤。僅「Near the exit」在圖中沒有對應的出口。
